turns.text: Good morning, I wanted to check on my recent order.
Sure, my customer ID is CUST-007.
Yes, that's correct. And the order number I'm calling about is ORD-7001.
Okay, so when exactly will the backordered item ship out? I want to know when I should expect that one.
Got it, so the first part arrives this week and the backordered item will come later. Do you have a specific date for when that second shipment will arrive?
Alright, that helps. Thanks for clarifying both timelines for me. I appreciate your help.
